title: A customer on the shop's own term over its limit gets the warning and badge
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds the shop's own term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, has a credit limit of $500.00, unpaid invoices totalling $600.00 and an open work order {Work-order-1}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S9-09 Customer, {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S9-09 Fourteen and {Work-order-1} is S2-15446.
  • Starting screen: the Work Orders page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Work Order".
  2. Pick {Customer-A} as the customer.
  3. Confirm the New Work Order window with its create button.
  4. Open {Work-order-1}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the New Work Order window opens.
  • Step 2: the window shows {Customer-A} as the customer.
  • Step 3: a confirmation opens titled "Confirmation" with the message "Are you sure you want to open a new work order? This customer is over their credit limit." and the buttons "Create" and "Cancel", worded exactly as before the release.
  • Step 4: the "Over limit" badge shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11678 (Story 9, Over Credit warning)

  • S9-E1: “A customer on one of the shop's own terms is treated like a Net customer: the warning shows when their balance exceeds a limit above $0.”
  • Key Decisions: “The shop's own terms behave like Net terms: Charge Account allowed, invoicing never blocked.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
